name: v1.8.7
body:
Adds prepared listing JSON to avoid repeated decoding and rebuilding of server payloads on listing reads. Prepared reads are disabled by default and support bounded backfill and flag rollback. Listing rows release their database connection before JSON processing; pool defaults remain 60/10.

Focused response/update/delete/backfill/rollback checks passed. Local encoding benchmarks over saved public records measured 63% less encoding time and 88% fewer allocations. These are encoding-cost results, not a peak-capacity guarantee. Broad staging replay remained inconclusive for capacity due to generator port exhaustion and losses.

name: v1.8.6
body:
This release improves registry search performance under mixed search, pagination and publishing traffic.

- Select search page keys through covering indexes before fetching complete records.
- Plan searches for their actual parameter values to handle broad and rare terms reliably.
- Optimize namespace suffix searches and require at least three Unicode characters for nonempty search terms (shorter searches return HTTP 422).
- Include reproducible cyclic-load benchmarks and repeated staging validation against a public production-data snapshot.

Deployment: prebuild and verify migrations 016/017 indexes concurrently on busy databases. The validated burst capacity uses a 3-CPU PostgreSQL quota on the existing nodes, with the application connection pool unchanged. See deploy/README.md and tools/readbench/STAGING_SEARCH_RESULTS.md for procedure, evidence and limitations.

name: v1.8.5
body:
This release adds production performance diagnostics: request arrivals and backlog, database pool/query metrics, and bounded slow-listing logs correlated with ingress request IDs. Slow-request logs separate connection acquisition, query/fetch waits, row decoding, and response processing, including snapshots while requests remain stuck.

It also includes publisher fixes for P-384 signatures and repository IDs, GitLab subgroup URL support, and stricter validation of incomplete repository metadata and invalid arguments. Previously stored invalid metadata may need correction when republishing or editing.

The ingress cache/timing log fields require the accompanying infrastructure rollout. Application release artifacts alone do not deploy the hosted registry. No new database migration is included.
